summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze confidential launch data, find where the plan says ok but reality doesn't, and build and demo a product (Lighthouse) that rechecks, acts via agents, and copes with new drops before the 12:45 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found the real launch risks (art book overbooking, failed statues, rev B/C sleeves, card shortfall) and built a polling, versioned, agent-driven Lighthouse app with role split, case flows, routines and open demo hosted on ada at lighthouse.stenglein.dev. Pushed to GitHub, with a late fix making Maren's escalation request her main view; that fix was verified on a throwaway copy but not yet committed or deployed to ada.

repo: Portal API has only list files, get file and archive.zip; no notifications or webhooks. Changes must be detected by polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, and existing files get replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ and .env; .env.example is committed. Entire hooks only create checkpoints when repo files change, and push checkpoint refs on git push.
scripts/demo.sh has an open mode (ASK_DEMO_OPEN=on, ASK_DEMO_HOST=...) and save-story/story commands to restore a prepared demo state; reset on ada via ssh with PATH including ~/.local/bin.
Team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; teammates push to main concurrently (Lucas README, Farhan's image-plugin-pipeline), so pushes can be rejected as non-fast-forward.
Launch verdict text previously did not know the viewer's role; role now has to be passed in so Maren sees 'with you' and Felix sees 'with Maren'.
Demo state needs a server restart for sign-in logo, bell turn-off endpoint and Felix's title setting; web-build-only changes are served without restart.
workflow: Verify hosting claims with a traced request carrying a unique marker and check which machine's log shows it, rather than relying on cloudflared tunnel info, which listed a stale tunnel.
Do not build the web app while a recorder is mid-take, since page reloads would change the video halfway through.
Restarting the cloudflared tunnel to add a hostname takes all hosts down for about a minute; moving hosting is safest by building on the new host first and repointing DNS last.
Tests of the Maren sign-off path change demo state, so always reset to the story snapshot afterwards; one reset was skipped after an interrupt and left art books 'sent'.
Use a throwaway copy of the story state for screenshots and click tests to avoid corrupting the demo.

friction: Subagent-run commands and interrupted tool calls left commits and demo state ambiguous (commits landed before the stop, reset after Maren test did not run).
Tunnel restart in tmux failed first on a wrong session name, taking all three addresses down (530) until restarted.
Recorder wrote frames only at the end, so stopping it early produced no video; the demo video was never produced.
Another chat edited the Mac copy (two commits), and another agent disagreed about where lighthouse was served; confusion from stale cloudflared info.
Maren's escalation screen still showed Felix's Done state and a tiny request row after switching roles.
Repeated demo resets requested many times because tests and recordings mutate state.
Confidential data and .env with keys were copied onto a shared university account (ada).
open_items: Commit and deploy the Maren main-view/ForYourOk fix (OkPage embeddable, Done cleared on role change) to ada; it was only verified on a throwaway copy.
bf486bb (role-aware verdict) and the other chat's cf6a9ed and e2d9098 are local-only and not pushed; the latter two are unreviewed and not on ada.
Reset ada demo data to the story state before the next demo or recording.
Demo video not produced; record it or have the user do it with voice before 12:45.
